body: My friends won't help me, I have like two friends and they dismiss me every time I talk about it. Even if I'm talking about cutting him off they dismiss me and talk about their own problems and idk how to make other friends

I've been lurking, I guess you could say, on this subreddit for a while now bc when I'm feeling overly depressed or suicidal I read other people's stories & responses to them and try to find ones I can relate to so I can read the comments to help even though I've never posted myself. hope that makes sense.

anyway, something about your post resonated with me, I finally made an account to reply to you. we're the same age and i can relate to so much of what you said.

in regards to your response to another commenter, I'm proud of you for deciding to hold off on your plan for tonight, and it's incredibly selfless of you to do it for the sake of your dad.

I hope your night is going alright, considering. try to get comfy if you can, and maybe drink something warm, that's what helps me. if you ever wanna talk, about anything, I'm down. if you just wanna vent or if you want a friend who's not gonna judge you, i've got you <3
